title: DETECTLANGUAGE stores with _xlfn. (XLSB variable-arg id 255) and is deferred as an external translation service
statement: In Excel 16.0 build 20430, DETECTLANGUAGE(text) is stored in OOXML and XLSB as a variable-argument future function with the _xlfn. prefix (_xlfn.DETECTLANGUAGE(1), XLSB function id 255). Runtime evaluation requires Microsoft's remote language-detection service, so DNA Calc defers it as ExternalService and zero Excel calculation answers are recorded.
basis: Based on Excel 16.0.20430 file-format captures in DnaCalc crates/calc-doc/tests/fixtures/d1/excel-prefixes.json and crates/calc-doc/tests/fixtures/dc_5sr/excel-function-ids.json, and DnaCalc's deferral in crates/calc-catalogue/src/unheld.rs.
inferred: Runtime evaluation behaviour (offline errors, non-text coercion, empty-text handling, and multi-cell spilling) is inferred as dependent on Microsoft Translation Services and remains unmeasured in CalcFunc-Evidence.
open: No Excel calculation rows for DETECTLANGUAGE are recorded; offline, non-text, empty-text, and array-spill behaviour remain unmeasured.
